note: Built from the official trophy descriptions and PowerPyx's roadmap. One playthrough is enough: there is no mission replay and no New Game+, but free-roam stays open after the story and nothing on the 100% checklist is missable.

stages.summary: Play the five chapters and take optional missions as they appear. Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars as you go — both count toward the 100% checklist later. Do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house the morning after Down to Earth (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the only thing that may be missable. Keep a save at the start and end of each chapter: there are 15 manual save slots and no mission replay.
stages.title: Step 1 — Finish the story
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

stages.summary: After the credits, the 100% checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Everything you did during the story already counts. You need any 70 of the 80 challenges, 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, 15 of 18 meditations, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all 12 shooting ranges golded and all 42 drone races won. It is roughly 60% true completion, not a real 100%.
stages.title: Step 2 — The 100% checklist

stages.summary: Strangers & Freaks are not needed for the 100% checklist, so finish the 8 counting strands now (Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete), plus the character questlines for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, and any secret trophies left — the tank, the plane at VCIA, the bowling alley, max Strength for both characters. Then the platinum pops.
stages.title: Step 3 — Strangers, characters and cleanup

warnings: Cheats disable trophies and saving — keep trophy runs cheat-free (PowerPyx).
There is no mission replay: keep a save at the start and end of each chapter (PowerPyx).
The Chapter 1 meditation is the only possibly missable trophy (PowerPyx, GTA Zone).
The final meditation needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break (PowerPyx).
Avoid the Irredeemable criminal profile — it is permanent (PowerPyx).
